caption: The drawing shows a rectangular piece of fabric with frayed edges placed on a plain light beige background. The main area of the fabric is filled with a textured blue-gray color that serves as the background. Scattered regularly across this background are identical floral motifs: each motif features a stylized flower with pink and red petals, a yellow base, small round yellow buds, and green leaves. Each flower is accompanied by a brown, curved, loop-like element extending beside or behind it. The floral motifs and loops are arranged in a diagonal pattern and are evenly spaced across the fabric. The drawing appears to represent a fabric sample, with the patterned portion sharply outlined and the edges of the cloth visibly uneven or frayed.
title: Calico
